title: Three hats, one engineer
sub: I move between these every day — the engineering informs the research, and the research makes the engineering better.

items.title: AI Engineer
items.desc: Designing and shipping ML systems — retrieval pipelines, model serving, evaluation loops, and the glue that turns a notebook into something real users can hit.

items.title: Backend Developer
items.desc: Building the infrastructure underneath it all — APIs, data pipelines, queues, and the reliability work that keeps systems fast and upright under load.

items.title: AI Researcher
items.desc: Studying the methods, not just using them — implementing ideas from first principles, evaluating them rigorously, and writing them up as reproducible published work.
